findings.what: The target asks for 'the declaration's full name and its module' on each reference's line. In seven places the closer, reading the target, kept the name already on the line before and put only the module on the reference line. The closer disclosed this in REPORT.questions. In six of the seven the preceding name carries its namespace relative to Causal (`Causality.CurvesExtend` ×4, `Causal.isolatedLine_scOpen_without_tarentin`, root-level `timelikeLine_chronalCurveOn_iff`). At SubArc:53 it is the bare `exists_inextensible_of_t1_secondCountable`, without the `Causality.` namespace that the target's example form and the same docstring use (:56, `Causality.Inextensible.exists_subArc_of_le`). It resolves uniquely: the whole library has one declaration with that last component, Causal.Causality.exists_inextensible_of_t1_secondCountable, in the cited module. So the reference is unambiguous, but it is not the full name.
